notes.title: NEW UPDATE 1.25 INTRODUCES JAPANESE, KOREAN AND CHINESE LANGUAGES INTO THE GAME!
notes.notes:
Hello Horror fans,

[h3][b]We are adding 4 new languages to Song of Horror. Now, you can face The Presence and play the true horror in Korean, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, or Simplified Chinese![/b][/h3]

The new update opens the chance for more players over the globe to discover the hidden secrets of Song of Horror. We recognized there was a big group of Japanese, Korean and Chinese players supporting us, so we decided to work on integrating these languages into the game interface and subtitles, as part of our efforts to make it accessible to as many players as possible.

We hope that this new addition helps you investigate the scariest places and solve the most challenging puzzles. We also encourage you to keep sharing your best moments through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1096570/discussions/]Steam forums[/url]... unless The Presence hunts you first.

Let the Horror begin,

[i]The Protocol Games & Raiser Games Teams.[/i]

notes.title: Introducing Song of Horror Hotfix 1.23
notes.notes:
Dear Song of Horror fans,

We are sharing with you a brief changelog detailing today's hotfix:

[h3][u]Hotfix 1.23[/u][/h3]

Fixed a graphical bug on the ending cutscene with Erica.

[u]Known bugs[/u]

We're tracking the following errors and they'll be fixed as soon as possible:
[list]
[*] The "Voices" omen can trigger a freeze in ultra graphic settings. To prevent it, we recommend reducing the "render quality" option in your settings to 93%.

notes.title: New H.P. Lovecraft Difficulty Available Now! Introducing Update 1.22
notes.notes:
Dear Song of Horror fans,

[b]Today we introduce several, highly requested new features to Song of Horror![/b] You can now experience the hardest difficulty, H.P. Lovecraft, play as fan-favorite Erica in Episode 5, and face new scares and manifestations of The Presence.

We promised to add these three new elements to Song of Horror to keep improving the game beyond launch and to offer all of you new content to look forward to. This would not be possible without your participation in the community, so thank you for being so vocal and encouraging in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1096570/discussions/]the Steam forums[/url] and in your reviews!

[h3]Now, go and play the newest content Song of Horror has to offer![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/9508367be332303ff53adea90ddd6143362f127b.gif[/img]

[h3]Here's everything Update 1.22 introduces to Song of Horror:[/h3]

[h3][u]H.P. LOVECRAFT[/u][/h3]

[b]H.P. Lovecraft difficulty is now available![/b] H.P. Lovecraft is Song of Horror’s hardest difficulty level. You can unlock this new difficulty after beating the game for the first time in M.R. James or Edgar Allan Poe.
[list]
[*] The unlocking of H.P. Lovecraft is not retroactive: it won't unlock automatically if you already completed the game on M.R. James or Edgar Allan Poe. However, what you can do is watch the final cutscene again to unlock H.P. Lovecraft.
[*] H.P. Lovecraft is a global unlock. Once you obtain it, you’ll be able to select H.P. Lovecraft in any of your save slots.
[*] In H.P. Lovecraft, death (or worse!) lurks around every corner. The difficulty of all five Hauntings has been noticeably increased, and they will appear slightly more frequently than in Edgar Allan Poe. Lesser events will also tend to be more... malignant than before.
[*] Be on your guard! No tutorials will show up in H.P. Lovecraft (they are still accessible from the "Tutorials" section of the Pause menu), and you might find yourself facing dangers you didn’t expect.
[*] For those achievement hunters among us, you can now unlock a brand new one for completing the entire game on H.P. Lovecraft difficulty: [b]"The Presence waits dreaming".[/b]
[*] You can also change difficulty at any time between H.P. Lovecraft and the other three difficulty levels with no restrictions. However, doing this will prevent you from getting the achievement associated with H.P. Lovecraft, so think carefully before committing.
[/list]
[h3][u]EPISODE 5: NEW PLAYABLE CHARACTER AND EVENTS[/u][/h3]

[b]Erica Färber is now playable in Episode 5![/b] After going through unspeakable horrors at the Abbey of Saint Cecilia and the antique store, a final answer still eludes Erica, and as you know, she’s not one to sit idly by...
[list]
[*] To unlock Erica as a playable character in Episode 5, she needs to be present in Episode 4 and survive the ordeal (she doesn't need to be the one who finishes the episode). This is not retroactive: it will unlock on successful Episode 4 runs from now on.
[*] We also added [b]several instances of random paranormal activity[/b] to Jeremy Hartwood Mental Hospital. Now, your adventure through this cursed place will be scarier than ever before!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/6b6331181807e9701162e88dd74dcdea890c3d31.gif[/img]

[h3][u]THE ABYSS[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare bug where dodging an arm grab in the last second could result in your character still being grabbed and the associated icon not being properly shown.
[/list]
[h3][u]GENERAL[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed several translations and minor bugs.
[*] Fixed a bug where a certain combination of button/key presses could send you flying towards the last door you interacted with (The Presence can be really silly if it wants too).
[*] Fixed several minor sound issues.
[/list]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/UuHodhpgVpnSHPm3YZ/source.gif[/img]

Once again, we want to thank you all for supporting Song of Horror and being a part of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1096570/discussions/]this community[/url]. That's why we want to [b]highlight some of our favorite comments from the last few weeks[/b]. Enjoy!

[quote=蛤釦子][i]"After playing the 2 first episodes this became my fav horror game in the recent decade. The leap from the demo [...] to its final product is incredible, thank you for the passion to deliver this game."[/i][/quote]蛤釦子

[quote=Julinya][i]"You all seem so passionate about making the game that it makes me want it even more!! It looks amazing!"[/i][/quote]Julinya

[quote=GP][i]"This game is outright scary, playing it right now and I'm shitting my pants on those damned jump scares lol"[/i][/quote]GP

[quote=GP][i]"Dude! Amazing game! Love the graphics are just so cool! And everything is just pure wow!"[/i][/quote]Eliyah YM

Last but not least, a friendly reminder that [b]Song of Horror is being featured on the Steam Summer Sales with a 25% discount![/b] We encourage you to recommend it or give it as a present to your friends (or to get it yourself if you still haven't).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096570/SONG_OF_HORROR_COMPLETE_EDITION/

[i]Stay safe. Stay strong.

The Protocol & Raiser Games Teams

[h3]Oh my god... It ends… like this.[/h3][/i]

notes.title: The 1st Post-Launch Update is Here! Check Out Update 1.21
notes.notes:
Dear Song of Horror fans,

Although the game is already out, we are still working hard on Song of Horror. Today, we introduce the first of several post-launch updates. This one focuses on general tweaks to the whole title, which include bug fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and important changes to the photograph puzzle in Episode 5, making it more accessible and easier to solve.

[b]Here's everything Update 1.21 adds to Song of Horror:[/b]

[h3]EPISODE 2[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed some locations where The Silence could get stuck.
[*] You should no longer get stuck when watching through Erica’s peephole.
[/list]

[h3]EPISODE 3[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug which could cause you to not be able to obtain the slides if you used the power adapter before obtaining them.
[*] Added new cutscenes to the Interlude.
[/list]

[h3]EPISODE 5[/h3]
[list]
[*] The infamous photograph puzzle now registers when it gets correctly assembled and gives you the photograph plus the information paper as a document.
[*] Added several clues to the information document in the photograph puzzle.
[*] You can now access the completed photograph (if you have it) when inside the keypad puzzle.
[*] Fixed a puzzle icon appearing on the map when it shouldn’t.
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes your character wouldn’t use the stethoscope when listening at doors.
[*] Fixed a rare instance of The Presence interfering with The First Dream’s starting cutscene.
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes you could get stuck after obtaining the flare box.
[*] Fixed a bug which could cause the security panel buttons to disappear.
[*] Fixed several translation bugs.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/2b4eea4caf3e66a287d74abdd4913cddca9a53f7.gif[/img]

[h3]FINALE[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Ariadne glowing in the dark when you approached her with your flashlight off (reminded us of [url=https://youtu.be/TxW3-eqJQcI]this scene[/url]).
[*] Fixed the music box reappearing once you return from There.
[*] Fixed several interaction bugs with puzzles in Husher and Berenice’s nightmares.
[/list]

[h3]GENERAL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused resolution to not stick properly.
[*] Fixed some VR devices from automatically launching upon Song of Horror being run (The Presence was trying to escape to other mediums!!!)
[*] Fixed a controller issue where using the controller stick to change between “Yes” and “No” options upon selecting Daniel or an Episode 5 character would cause your chosen personal and collectible items to also change.
[*] Removed some UI leftovers from the character selection screen.
[*] Fixed a setting in the “Ultra” effects configuration that would cause an undue performance impact.
[*] Added missing sound effects and fixed some existing ones.
[*] Fixed some bugs with the characters’ in-game voice lines.
[/list]

[h3]THE ABYSS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the arm grab icons sometimes staying after the event had been successfully completed.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/075e65d809fe5490030e7289bbfd9b9d6ed5807a.gif[/img]

[h3]We encourage you to participate in our lively community by sharing your thoughts and comments about the game on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1096570/discussions/]Steam forums[/url], or by leaving a review of Song of Horror![/h3]

Here are some of the most heartwarming comments you've left us in the last few weeks!

[quote=Console Player][i]"Thank you, devs, for this amazing game. This came at a time when I really needed something in my life to bring joy, to make me smile, to make me scared of turning the next corner. So once again, thank you devs.
P.S. Erica is best girl, no dispute."[/i][/quote]
Console Player

[quote=mahorin a.v.][i]"Devs, nurses from Alchemilla hospital asked me to tell you that they are proud of you."[/i][/quote]
mahorin a.v.

[quote=North_Station][i]"I love you for the game AND for this great implementation (E.T.A. Hoffmann)! I love the challenge, but it was always a bit frustrating for my stream and also for my viewers to have to see the spots over and over again after a certain time. I'm happy to finish the last episode <3"[/i][/quote]
North_Station

[i]Keep on keeping on.

The Protocol & Raiser Games Teams.

[h3]There's no turning back. I have to push forward. I need to know...[/h3][/i]

notes.title: Episode 5 Launch Update: Check All the New Tweaks and Features Here!
notes.notes:
Dear Song of Horror fans,

We are introducing a new update to Song of Horror, just in time for the launch of Episode 5! This patch is designed to [b]introduce a couple of new (and highly requested!) features[/b], as well as several quality-of-life adjustments.

[h3][b]Here's everything we are featuring in Song of Horror today with Update 1.2:[/b][/h3]
[h3][u]GENERAL[/u][/h3][list]
[*] E.T.A. Hoffmann mode is now available! E.T.A. Hoffmann is a new difficulty level that maintains the same general difficulty as M.R. James but, whenever you lose a character, you’ll be able to choose to load a previous checkpoint instead of succumbing to permanent death.
[*] Difficulty can now be changed up and down anytime during the game, with no restrictions, except one notable exception: changing difficulty in the middle of an ongoing dangerous event will not affect said event. Certain achievements still require a specific difficulty level to be maintained throughout the entirety of a given episode (or the entire game!) to be unlocked.
[*] Lots of minor bugs, graphical glitches, and subtitle errors have been fixed.
[/list]
[h3][u]THE DARKNESS[/u][/h3][list]
[*] Shortened The Darkness’ duration to more appropriate levels. Now it won't take too long to know whether you survived... or you perished!
[*] Fixed a bug causing The Darkness to sometimes be harder than expected.
[*] Changed The Darkness’ feedback icon: now, the icon will become filled with white starting from the edge all the way to the center before receding again. Success will come by pressing the appropriate key/gamepad button when the icon is completely filled with white.
[*] Both the heartbeat sounds and the event’s tutorial (accessible from the “Tutorials” section in the Pause Menu) have been updated to reflect these changes.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/24cf53d9ade5a4c86507ef6471f74b718c450bff.gif[/img]
[h3][u]THE SILENCE[/u][/h3][list]
[*] Updated the breathing icon to be more accurate. Now, you’ll have clearer feedback on whether you’re doing good or not.
[/list]
[h3][u]EPISODE 1[/u][/h3][list]
[*] The final hallway has been remade to better reflect where you’re going.
[*] Fixed an uncommon bug that could cause interactable items to randomly swap with each other causing abnormal behaviors. A notable example was the entrance of the house, which could be blocked. If this bug affects you, all you need to do is restart the episode to have it fixed.
[/list]
[h3][u]EPISODE 4[/u][/h3][list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause you to get stuck when you lose a character in the Basilica or in adjacent areas by blocking the well and preventing you from picking up the victim’s items.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause you to be able to finish the episode without gathering the four ornate keys.
[*] The mausoleum door leading to the Prior’s confession has been given greatly increased chances of opening (it opens randomly).
[*] Fixed a bug with the Tarot deck causing it to not work as intended.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause Etienne to appear in the ending sequence despite having been lost.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/d7fe1a1565e8c83f79b8974b968746684c2a1ea4.gif[/img]

As always, [b]we encourage you to leave your feedback, thoughts, and opinions on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1096570/discussions/]the Steam forums[/url][/b]. We listen to each and every one of you, and we always take your comments into consideration.

To finish this update off, here are some of the lovely answers you have left us during the last days!

[i]"No words guys. Greatly done with a lot of love. Thank you!"[/i]
mahorin.a.v.

In relation to the references found inside the game: [i]"I am sorry, the Presence is watching me and I cant notice those due to fear."[/i]
Hyrenapth

[i]"Take the time you need to make this Episode as good as the rest, congratulations for this game we were missing innovative, chilling horror, the one you don't know where it's coming from. If you read me, I hope that after this game you bring us more things as polished and made with so much love, cheers, and great work."[/i]
Shockpunk

[i]Stay Strong.

The Protocol & Raiser Games Teams.

[h3]Hello?
Is that... music?
I better take a look.[/h3][/i]

notes.title: New Episode 5 Update: Lidia, Ariadne, The Presence, and much more!
notes.notes:
Dear Song of Horror fans,

[h3][b]Two weeks left before the launch of Episode 5!!![/b][/h3]
We are so close to the last verse of the song! Everything is coming to an end: The horrors you witnessed. The answers you needed. The characters that you lost, and those who survived. And The Presence, now fully unleashed, connecting them all.

Make sure to check [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1096570/view/2189254554278415610]our first update[/url] where we [b]show Jeremy Hartwood, share some details about the start of the story and more[/b]! And now, here's some new stuff you will find in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158111/SONG_OF_HORROR_Episode_5/]Episode 5[/url]:

[h3]Playing with Lidia for the first time[/h3]
You all know Lidia since the beginning of Episode 2. She is a dear friend of Daniel, a committed social worker with a tragic past. During the 70s and the 80s, Lidia witnessed many friends and even love interests fall prey to heroin addiction. Since then, she assists people in poor neighborhoods, jails, conflict zones... Wherever she can.

Lidia met Daniel at her rehab program, where she guided him on his struggle against alcoholism. She became to his eyes a savior angel, and one of his best friends to date. Now, she is ready to commit the ultimate act of selflessness: [b]help Daniel get rid of the foreboding Song of Horror.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/2c5aa7fd842371ec0a515f2eb8de1609df5a9aa2.gif[/img]
[h3]Understanding the past to change the future[/h3]
In your terrifying adventure through Jeremy Hartwood mental hospital, you will find clues on the sinister events that took place there. One doctor in particular, Berenice Prestegard, seems to know more than anyone else. After all, she was the professional analyzing the mental state of Ariadne LeGrant-Amsberg when she was a child...

In certain moments of Episode 5, you will have the opportunity to [b]play as Dr. Prestegard in brief flashbacks from the 1920s[/b]. These scenes from the past will shed some light on the mysteries behind the LeGrant-Amsberg family, the song, and of course, The Presence. Will you be able to handle the truth?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/8da42ede3657c7d02e04610a145dc808a6d4cc98.gif[/img]
[h3]Ariadne, the central piece of the puzzle[/h3]
Through Berenice's flashbacks, you will meet Ariadne as a child. She hasn't changed much since then: driven mad by the effects of the song, everything she does and says doesn't seem to make any sense at all. Maybe this last trip will help you finally understand her, unraveling the warped thoughts trapped in the corners of her deranged mind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/88f4ce09dae2533da646062ac699b79b5f4ebd8d.gif[/img]
[h3]The Presence, unchained[/h3]
We have unleashed the Presence into Jeremy Hartwood! We are making sure that it behaves properly with our final tweaks, hunting you down through the creepy alleys of the hospital when you least expect it.

You are in its domains now: you can stay quiet, you can hide, you can run... But it will eventually catch up to you. Make sure to find everything you need to put on an end to its curse. This is your last chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/23a83708113fdb2c2ba1d2ac09eb1f0e52b5f9b6.gif[/img]
[h3]The coda to the Song of Horror[/h3]
We have spent [b]the last six years of our lives[/b] creating Song of Horror, our unique take on survival horror. It hasn't been easy: developing the AI behind The Presence, designing the mechanics tied to the permadeath, and building the Song of Horror universe were steep challenges to overcome. We are proud to see how everything is coming along. But most importantly, we are so happy to see how you all are embracing this experience. The last moments of Song of Horror will leave you all speechless!

[i]Beware of The Presence!

The Protocol & Raiser Games Teams

[h3]It's all over. Just a moment ago… I…[/h3][/i]

notes.title: Song of Horror's Biggest Update: Here's Everything We Are Adding to Episode 4
notes.notes:
Dear Song of Horror fans,

We are introducing our biggest update to date right now! This patch features [b]important changes to Episode 4[/b], bringing it closer to the experience we originally wanted to create. As such, you can expect new features and improvements destined to craft a scarier, and tenser atmosphere throughout the whole episode (which means you are going to have a really bad time!).

Here's the new content we are adding to Episode 4 (and a couple of tweaks in Episode 3!):

[h2]UPDATE 1.14[/h2]
[h3]EPISODE 4[/h3][list]
[*] [b]25 new paranormal events[/b]: St. Cecilia's Abbey is officially the most haunted place in Song of Horror. You can expect more scares than ever before!
[*] An original collectible: [b]The Tarot Deck[/b]. Find five fate-altering confessions from those consumed by The Presence to resist its most lethal attacks.
[*] [b]New cutscenes[/b] + animation fixes: We introduced more cinematic moments and tweaked several animations from characters during said scenes.
[*] [b]A new illustrated cutscene[/b] at the end of the episode, adding more context and emotion before the last episode.
[*] The "Ornate keys" now combine into a single item upon having more than one of them.
[*] Blocked a door that should not have opened from the start (It was The Presence trying to mess with us!)
[*] The Scriptorium blocked door can now be opened from the inside, more exploration possibilities!
[*] Removed Cold event from St. Cecilia's Abbey: we feel this manifestation of The Presence was redundant, and that this Episode's pace benefits from its removal.
[*] Deeper color scheme: both the interiors and exteriors of St. Cecilia are now visually enhanced
[*] Improved sound ambient: events, animations, and scenes display better sounding effects
[*] Several bugs fixes, gameplay tweaks, and quality-of-life improvements throughout the whole episode.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/51093d91fec42c4da7946b84030c8b2cc523348a.gif[/img]
[h3]What are Daniel and Sophie talking about?[/h3]
[h3]EPISODE 3[/h3][list]
[*] Tweaks on [b]Interlude: End of the Road[/b]. We reworked the main puzzle of Husher's Interlude to add more depth in both its explanation and solution.
[*] A new cutscene at the end of the Episode involving The Presence (spooky!)
[*] Lightning enhancements in the Great Library: to improve the final section of the Episode
[/list]
We encourage you to [b]keep sharing your thoughts and opinions [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1096570/discussions/]on the Steam Forums[/url][/b]. We are listening and considering your feedback as we move forward into the final episode. Thank you for being a part of this amazing community!

[h3][i]"That melody... I'm not gonna get it out of my head, am I?"[/i][/h3]

notes.title: Song of Horror Final Episode Launches May 14th, Ep. 4 Update Available Tomorrow
notes.notes:
Dear fans of Song of Horror,

We have important news to share with you. This has been a hard decision for us. However, we always envisioned this last episode as the completion of the story, and we believe it's important that you play the game we always intended to make when you experience Song of Horror as a whole. That is why we have decided to [b]move this launch to May 14th.[/b]

[h3]Why we decided to launch on May[/h3]

The final episode of Song of Horror (Ep.5), called "The Horror and The Song", marks the end of a journey that started in 2014, when we decided to bring to life the horror adventure we, as gamers, had always wanted to play. However, we are aware that Episode 4 still has room for improvement and polishing, and that its state does not reflect the quality level and game experience we aim for. We are fully committed to making the whole Song of Horror experience perfect. That's why we have been working on a big update that will add substantial changes to Episode 4, available tomorrow, while we continue working on a top-quality Ep.5 

[h3]Episode 4 Update[/h3]
[list][*] +15 new events: unique scares, unexpected encounters, haunting sequences...
[*] An original collectible: The Tarot Deck. Find the five cards in the Abbey to resist certain attacks of The Presence!
[*] Deeper color scheme: both the interiors and exteriors of St. Cecilia are now visually enhanced
[*] Improved sound ambient: events, animations, and scenes display better sounding effects
[*] Polished animations during scenes: we made some character adjustments to enhance the overall look of the cinematic moments
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/d50a5308a4a860d1281d2b038307462508cd4a83.gif[/img]
[h3]You will witness new manifestations of the monks of the Abbey[/h3]
Thank you once again for encouraging and inspiring us to make Song of Horror. We cannot wait to witness the end of this terrifying story alongside you.

[i]Protocol Games & Raiser Games[/i]

notes.title: Episode 4 Gameplay Patch is Here! Improving Your Visit to St. Cecilia's Abbey
notes.notes:
Dear horror fans,

Thank you for playing our latest episode! Watching you roam St. Cecilia's Abbey, the domains of the cursed Abbott and his monks, has been an absolute blast. We are having a lot of fun reading your reactions to the plot revelations in preparation for the surprising conclusion to the story we have in store for you.

We have been working hard during the last week to introduce [b]several important fixes[/b] to improve the gameplay experience of Episode 4, alongside a couple of general tweaks. Here's everything we are featuring in Song of Horror today, with [b]the 1.13 update[/b]:

[h3]GENERAL[/h3]
[list][*] The map should no longer forget to properly mark whether doors you have already interacted with are open or not, helping you to explore the episodes with more information
[/list]

[h3]EPISODE 2[/h3][list]
[*] Removed a bugged map interrogation icon.
[/list]

[h3]EPISODE 3[/h3][list]
[*] René's gun now has a unique use.
[/list]

[h3]EPISODE 4[/h3][list]
[*] Maxwell's Lucky Coin is now usable on intended situations. If you equip it, you'll know when you can use it.
[*] Fixed several blocking bugs with the cutscene playing after the four ornate keys are used.
[*] Fixed a bug that could block your character upon using the spirits bottle on the still.
[*] Fixed several minor yet very visible bugs happening during cutscenes.
[*] Fixed being able to remove pieces for the retractor during the animation played upon successfully assembling it.
[*] Fixed several white loading screens.
[*] Fixed being able to open the inventory/documents upon the Requiem finishing animation.
[*] Fixed some bugs affecting light sources on finishing The Requiem.
[*] Fixed a graphical bug with the cold event.
[*] Fixed several audio bugs with character phrases.
[*] Fixed several loading bugs.
[*] Fixed several texts which remained in Spanish.
[*] Fixed a few texts appearing when they shouldn't and others not appearing when they should.
[*] Toned The Presence down a tad to better compensate for Saint Cecilia's Abbey's vast extension (it's in its nature to misbehave)
[*] Parts of Saint Cecilia's Abbey should no longer fail to load.
[/list]

A big shoutout to everyone on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1096570/discussions/]the Steam forums[/url], who are always motivating us to move forward and give our best to deliver the horror game we always dreamed of. notes.title: New update following Episode 3 launch!
notes.notes:
Dear horror fans,

Thank you for playing through Episode 3 this week! We had a blast watching your reactions and reading your thoughts and opinions about this part of the story.

For those of you who haven't played it yet, or that want to experience it again, we have prepared a patch to improve the experience of A Twisted Trail, as well as a couple of general fixes. This is everything we are including in the [b]1.11 patch[/b]:

[h2]GENERAL[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a graphical bug that caused sharp FPS drops on camera change.
[*]Fixed a bug with the selection of additional personal items and collectible items on character select that could cause your choices to not be reflected in-game.
[/list]
[h2]THE ABYSS[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/ae840548b6aeba49552ecd0e8579adca570c1348.jpg[/img][list]
[*]Fixed a problem making The Abyss harder than intended.
[*]Fixed a bug which was causing the icons marking the dodge window for arm-grabs to not display at all.
[*]Fixed the character uttering a lot of phrases on overcoming The Abyss.
[*]Overcoming the first Abyss should now grant an achievement.
[*]Fixed a bug which could cause the wrong camera to be chosen after overcoming The Abyss.
[/list]
[h2]EPISODE 3[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/f79643020cbb7ef3e91109f6b418b8217f31003e.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem with The Door causing it to graphically glitch on spawn.
[*]Fixed a bug with The Silence causing the thing to not get closer when it should.
[*]In the Archive, After exiting the white screen door, your character should now hold their light source correctly.
[*]The painting child should now properly despawn in the Newspaper Archive.
[*]Fixed a bug which wouldn’t reset the difficulty of releasing yourself in the Great Library upon losing a character.
[*]Fixed an unintended use of Maxwell’s Lucky Coin which would cause your character to freeze.
[*]The broken camera in the Great Library shouldn’t break more than once anymore.
[*]Fixed being able to fix the camera before it actually breaking.
[*]Fixed several loading issues in The Great Library.
[*]Husher’s Haikus should now have matching text and image.
[*]Introduced a lot of new sound effects and fixed many more.
[*]Fixed a bug which could cause your selectable characters to be incorrect. Restarting Episode 3 (or any earlier episode) should now fix this issue for players still experiencing it. Also, Husher won't be Daniel anymore :)
[*]Fixed several audio bugs.
[*]Added some missing wall collisions in the Interlude.
[*]Changing between slides in the projector puzzle is now done manually so everyone can choose their preferred rhythm.
[*]Fixed a shelf interaction in the Archive that would freeze your character upon completion.  
[/list]

As usual, we also wanted to highlight one of your most heartwarming comments about Song of Horror: thank you so much!

[quote=Celeste Bright]Just wanted you to know: Song of Horror is *by far* the best horror adventure game in my fairly extensive Steam library so far - I've been searching for this unicorn for too many years. So many things done right, so much love and care was clearly put into this.
[i]"Celeste Bright"[/i][/quote]

[h3][i]
And do not forget: The Presence is always watching you...[/i][/h3]

notes.title: Song of Horror's first ever update is HERE! The Horror Continues...
notes.notes:
Dear horror fans,

We had a wonderful launch day on Halloween, playing live with all of you and enjoying the scariest night of the year together. We are so happy to read all your positive comments about Song of Horror! The reception of the game has been great overall, and we want to thank all of you for your support, love, and feedback...

...That's why we are able to introduce today [b]the first official update of Song of Horror[/b]! We've focused on improving and fixing several aspects of the game attending to your requests and petitions. You can take a look at everything we are adding to Song of Horror, including quality-of-life improvements, gameplay tweaks, audiovisual changes, and bug fixing:

[h1]THE PRESENCE[/h1][list]
[*] Fixed rare instance of lost characters appearing when they shouldn’t.
[*] Detecting danger when listening at doors should now be easier.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/cd366872dc4281e6a8761341d554b24cd680aac4.jpg[/img]

[h1]THE SILENCE[/h1][list]
[*] Characters now utter a voice phrase on overcoming The Silence.
[*] Added missing startled character sounds when The Silence begins.
[*] Fixed several instances of The Silence happening where it shouldn’t, causing bizarre camera bugs & possible blocks.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/e853935256775a0d7a0e9f6f696bd6b617062686.jpg[/img]

[h1]THE DARKNESS[/h1][list]
[*] Heartbeat sound has been adjusted for clarity.
[*] Increased heartbeats’ successful timing range, with an even greater increase in M.R. James difficulty.
[*] Slightly increased the average time between shrieks.
[*] Politely asked The Presence to stop generating Darkness events in some very specific places where your way to a hiding spot would be blocked.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590000/d728bea75c06c85fcb6a78e21fa197de9c0cebf6.jpg[/img]

[h1]EPISODE 1[/h1][list]
[*] Fixed some wrong texts belonging to Alina.
[*] Changed the sound you hear when listening to Saul’s room door to be more sinister and indicative of danger.
[/list]

[h1]EPISODE 2[/h1][list]
[*] Fixed some wrong texts belonging to Alexander.
[*] Fixed a wrong clue in the keys puzzle document.
[*] Fixed a loading bug that could happen on saving and quitting while standing on stairs, by which you’d be stuck in the wrong camera on loading, without your character in sight.
[*] Fixed several map icons related to Etienne’s note folder and several wrongly placed standard map icons.
[*] Fixed the character arm movement when using a Coltar token in the Coltar machine.
[*] Fixed a bug with Coltar messages’ texture.
[*] Fixed an instance of characters using voice lines from a different character than them.
[*] You no longer should lose all remaining characters when losing a character in the infinite hallway.
[*] Subtitles for “Recording 3 by Isaac Färber” should now be properly in sync with the audio.
[*] Fixed a few visual and audio bugs in the ending cinematic sequences.
[*] Added subtitle to Rene’s gun cocking for players with “Visual Cues” option enabled.
[/list]

[h1]GENERAL[/h1][list]
[*] Slightly tweaked speaking facial animations.
[*] Translated some texts which had been left in Spanish.
[*] Modified Resolution selector text to clarify it only affects resolution in Windowed mode. In Fullscreen mode, it should detect your screen’s native resolution if it’s 16:9, and the closest one if it isn’t.
[*] Added 1440p (2560x1440) resolution to Windowed Mode Resolution selector.
[/list]

Remember that more episodes are on their way. We cannot wait to share with all of you what we have in store for the next months, stay tuned!

[i]Beware of The Presence...[/i]
